newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside says Cossack oil to restart.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside says Cossack oil to restart.

text.p: The Cossack-Pioneer oil platorm is expected to resume production at about 0900 GMT on Thursday after strong winds forced a shut-down on Tuesday, a spokesman from the operator, Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday.
"The weather has abated enabling the offtake tanker to berth and start offloading and we expect the platform to restart production at about 5.00 p.m (0900 GMT)," the spokesman said.
Production was halted on Tuesday when the platform's storage tanks became full and the off-take tanker was unable to berth.
The Cossack field is off the northwest coast of Australia and is currently producing at about 85,000 barrel-per-day (bpd).
The field is equally owned by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG (MiMi) Pty Ltd, Chevron Corp and Royal Dutch/Shell group . -- Melbourne Bureau 61-3 9286-1435
